profiles.name: Additional sensors and remote monitoring
profiles.explanation: Per affected cabinet: 0.5 h sensor installation + 0.75 h wiring + 0.5 h configuration + 0.75 h functional testing. An extra 1 h rework applies to each affected already-assembled cabinet. Setup is 20 h per request.

profiles.name: Add sensors
profiles.explanation: Per affected cabinet: 1 h additional installation/wiring and 0.5 h additional checking. Rework on an already-assembled cabinet is a further 0.5 h. Setup is 8 h per request.

profiles.name: Add remote monitoring
profiles.explanation: Per affected cabinet: 0.75 h installation/configuration and 0.5 h additional checking. Rework on an already-assembled cabinet is a further 0.75 h. Setup is 12 h per request.

profiles.name: Replace a component
profiles.explanation: Example only: replace Component A with B. The cost is the full new component cost, with no credit for removed parts. Saved technical support represents the fictional compatibility assumption.

profiles.name: Change cabinet size or layout
profiles.explanation: Example only: a predefined larger enclosure / revised layout. Assembled cabinets need 3 additional rework hours each. No salvage credit. Different dimensions require a new assessment.

profiles.name: Add another machine connection
profiles.explanation: Example only: one supported extra machine connection per affected cabinet. Different loads or interfaces require technical assessment.

profiles.name: Change the protection requirements
profiles.explanation: Example only: a predefined protection upgrade kit and additional checks. This prototype does not certify safety or compliance or cover arbitrary protection ratings.

profiles.name: Increase the order quantity
profiles.explanation: Additional cabinets use the original configuration. Normal assembly hours per unit come from the order; additional testing is 0.5 h per new cabinet. The base unit cost already covers labour and materials. Stock is checked as complete material sets, valued at base cost less scheduled assembly/testing labour.

profiles.name: Request earlier delivery
profiles.explanation: Checks the unchanged remaining work against an earlier requested date. No overtime, extra resources or impact on other orders is assumed.

profiles.name: Other changes
profiles.explanation: Requires an order-specific Production assessment matching the request description, affected quantities and Production snapshot.
